result.description:
To manage the smooth and efficient running of all operations for our Well Testing product line. 
You will be responsible for ensuring the planning, directing, organising and sourcing of manpower and equipment to ensure clients operational activity is undertaken. Monitor performance to identify and implement improvements to achieve maximum operational efficiency and customer focus. Achieves agreed business goals and objectives whilst consistently ensuring expenditure is maintained in line with budget.

The main activities and accountabilities of this role include but are not limited to:
1. Ensure that all operations are performed in a professional, efficient, safe and cost-effective manner to provide quality service to the client
2. Ensure that all equipment, plant and substances used are suitable for the task and are kept in good working order. This includes the regular maintenance and servicing of equipment which will require close liaison with the workshop/maintenance
3. Monitor department’s performance to ensure service quality standards are being maintained; identify any areas for improvement and discuss recommendations with Management
4. Maintain close liaison with operational supervisors and coordinators to ensure full awareness of project progress and problems. Ensure high quality service is continually provided to achieve both the project and client performance indicators
5. Ensure that scheduling, planning and forecasting of the forward workload is regularly updated to ensure optimum use of resources
6. Review operational requirement and business needs; may propose requirements for capital expenditure to support future business requirements
7. Ensure that all invoicing is actioned in a timely manner and queries resolved as soon as possible to ensure payment and meet DSO targets
8. Ensure that the latest revision of documentation is used and outdated versions are removed from circulation; ensure that operational supervisors and crews are informed of, and understand any changes to, operations procedures and job planning paperwork
9. Ensure that all incidents and non-conformances are reported in line with the appropriate procedures and deadlines; ensure that all incidents are investigated, and corrective actions raised as required; where appropriate, participate in incident investigations
10. Ensure that equipment utilisation is monitored and that unutilised equipment is clearly identified; as necessary ensure that all 3rd party rental items are tracked to make certain that they are returned to the supplier at the earliest opportunity
11. Overall responsibility for the department budgets including gaining approval and then ensuring work plans etc. are put in place to achieve them. Be prepared to continually review expenditure and highlight any differentials to management. Prepare budget action plans for management review
12. Maintain close liaison at all times with clients or their representatives; seek to identify any further business opportunity
13. Develop a department recruitment and development plan that will meet the requirements of clients’ operations and future growth opportunities of the company
14. Supervise direct reports to ensure all operational, delivery, safety, Quality Management and financial targets are met
15. Liaise with the team members, internal departments and clients as and when required to ensure all aspects of the operations are discussed with the relevant parties to ensure effective communication to allow continued safe operations and task completion as per plan and budget

To be successful in your application you will have:
1. 10+ years industry experience within the Operational environment
2. Technical qualification
3. Previous Supervisory/Management experience

Role Summary:

Lead the Trading Activation of addressable marketing strategies via a team through market understanding, solution development skills, technical DSP/DMP/CDP expertise, and the communication of KINESSO recommendations through trusted agency & client relationships to meet client media objectives.

The Senior Activations Manager ensures all pacing and performance goals are met across all Addressable campaigns and acts as the trading lead across their client patch. Where applicable, they are responsible for the training, mentorship, and delegation of tasks to their direct reports/ junior trading members and are expected to be leaders in strategic thinking and optimization tactics. Ability to compare/contrast ad tech partners and recommend the best tools for a particular campaign are key.

Key Responsibilities

Partnership
1. industry changes, uncover benefits and Develop and nurture strong relationships with Agency team and direct clients to become a trusted source of Trading knowledge, owning the Trading relationship of a client portfolio.

2. Manage relationships with AdTech vendors and media partners to remain at the forefront of opportunities for clients to deliver business outcomes.

3. Collaborate with the Client Advisory team to extract optimal campaign performance and fulfill client objectives. Assist CA in brief responses and attend meetings as required.

4. Develop and nurture relationships with the wider Kinesso team, becoming a trusted source they can come to for questions around client insights, trading best practices etc.

Product

1. Provide insights to your Client Services and/or Agency Teams to assist with the overall digital strategy of future campaigns. Leading the charge on thought leadership across activations, encouraging innovation and test and learn opportunities to drive strategy.

2. Work with your Programmatic & Ad Ops Lead and the Digital Technology Manager to drive a culture of technology testing within your team.

3. Lead Campaign optimization strategies, training on new strategies and review/evaluation of these strategies, on behalf of your client.

4. Take lead in developing a measurement framework for your client patch.

5. Collaborate with Client Advisory & Product teams to ideate bespoke projects based on brand requirements, supporting digital acceleration and transformation.

Profile

1. Provide agency partners with thought leadership and education via curation of case studies for internal knowledge share.

2. Present relevant topics to the wider business to promote Kinesso solutions/results and share knowledge.

3. Participation in industry events for Kinesso representation and individual network growth.

4. Where possible, lead Kinesso involvement in client presentations.

Performance

1. Work to drive an overall trading vision for the client, driving the wider trading team to bring this to life.

2. Work with the Client Advisory team to push for client presentations showcasing trading outcomes, thought leadership work etc.

3. Identify direct reports knowledge gaps to familiarize with Kinesso solutions.

4. Lead campaign KPI fulfilment on behalf of client portfolio. Collaborate with Client Advisory team to extract optimal campaign performance, fulfill client objectives and hero campaign results through an insights led approach.

5. Assist in implementing processes to drive efficiencies within your client patch

6. Identify and assist in creation of innovation and test & learn projects.

7. Identify and lead digital growth opportunities for clients via channel diversification

People

1. Mentor, train and coach Client Advisory Associate (hybrid coordinator) and Trading Managers through an on-boarding and development framework.

2. If Applicable, Manage Associates and/or Managers, being responsible for their training and development within Kinesso

3. Provide daily direction to trading team via task management and prioritization in line with agency requests and client SLA’s.

4. Accountable for fostering culture within the team.


Salary between $86,000 to $90,000 inclusive of superannuation.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     HammondCare Waratah is currently looking for a Weekend Cook-Chef to join our team.

HammondCare has a unique model of care which places the resident's needs as our number one priority.

As a part of the Support Service's Team, you will support our model of care by delivering high quality meals within the MAIN KITCHEN at our Waratah Facility catering for our 232 residents in accordance with the organisational mission and mission in action statement.

Core Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Support Services Manager you will be responsible for;

Preparing nourishing, appetising, and culturally appropriate meals that meet individual dietary needs and preferences. This includes ensuring meals are visually appealing and served at the correct portion size and temperature.

Ensuring strict adherence to the Food Safety Program (FSP), HACCP standards, and all relevant health and safety regulations. This also involves complying with the Aged Care Quality Standards, specifically Standard 6: Food and nutrition.

Preparing residents' specific dietary requirements, including texture-modified food for those with swallowing difficulties (dysphagia).

Responding to feedback and addressing concerns promptly.

Maintaining accurate documentation related to food safety, resident dietary needs, and operational data.

To be successful in this role, you will:

Be flexible and able to commit to a range of shifts including weekends.

Value teamwork but also be able to work independently and show initiative.

Must have experience in cooking for large numbers in a commercial kitchen and or an aged care environment.

Have an understanding of The vulnerable persons guidelines for food safety or willingness to learn and incorporate these into your everyday work routine.

Demonstrated understanding of safe manual handling practices.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience in preparing and cooking bulk meals.

What are the benefits of working with HammondCare?

Flexible working environment to deliver a healthy work-life balance.

Gain access to multiple health and fitness facilities at a low fee with Fitness Passport

Be supported & empowered in your role to really make a difference to our residents.

A workplace trainer on each site committed to your ongoing training & development.

Access to not-for-profit salary sacrificing arrangements.

Shift times.

0630-1500

0900-1730

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity that has been serving families in Australia since 1932. We are an organisation that is led by our values, our passion is improving the quality of care for people in need.

As one of Australia's most innovative health & aged care providers, we champion life for every person in our care.

Company Name: EVER BUILD CONSTRUCTIONS GROUP PTY LTD
Location: Wentworthville NSW 2145
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company 
EVER BUILD CONSTRUCTIONS GROUP PTY LTD is a New South Wales-based residential construction company specialising in custom homes, duplexes, renovations and residential building projects. The company is committed to delivering high-quality workmanship, innovative building solutions and reliable service while ensuring every project meets the highest standards of quality and client satisfaction.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Carpenter to join our team in Wentworthville, New South Wales 2145. The successful candidate will undertake a wide range of carpentry duties associated with residential construction projects, including measuring, cutting, assembling, installing and repairing timber structures and fixtures in accordance with construction standards, building codes and project specifications.

Key Responsibilities
• Interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications to determine materials, measurements and installation requirements.
• Select and prepare timber and other building materials and organise layouts for carpentry work.
• Measure, cut and shape timber and related materials using hand and power tools to meet project specifications.
• Assemble and install structural frameworks, sub-flooring systems and floorboards while ensuring accuracy and stability.
• Fit and secure building components including door frames, window frames, skirting and other structural fixtures.
• Construct and join timber components to form structures and fittings ready for installation.
• Repair, replace or renovate damaged wooden structures, fittings and flooring components as required.
• Inspect completed carpentry work to ensure compliance with building standards, safety requirements and project specifications.

Essential Skills and Experience
• AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Carpentry, or an equivalent qualification.
• At least one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as a Carpenter.
• Strong understanding of construction techniques, timber materials and flooring installation methods.
•Ability to read and interpret building plans and technical drawings.
• Proficiency in using carpentry tools, machinery and measuring equipment.

Why Join Our Team
• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
• Stable employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
• Supportive and professional working environment.
• Access to modern tools, equipment and quality materials.
• Opportunity to work on high-quality residential construction projects with an established

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing residential construction company, please submit your resume outlining your skills, qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Carpenters who are committed to delivering quality workmanship.

Job Advertisement: Carpenter
Company Name: ARISE INFRA PTY LTD
 Location: Acacia Ridge, QLD 4110
 Job Type: Full-time
 Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company
ARISE INFRA PTY LTD is a Queensland-based residential building company specialising in the design and construction of high-quality custom family homes. The company is committed to delivering aesthetically appealing, functional, and customisable homes that meet the unique needs of its clients while maintaining exceptional standards of craftsmanship, quality, and customer service. With a strong focus on innovative home designs and reliable construction solutions, ARISE INFRA PTY LTD has established a reputation for excellence across Queensland.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Carpenter to join our team in Acacia Ridge, Queensland. The successful candidate will undertake a wide range of carpentry duties associated with residential construction projects, including measuring, cutting, assembling, installing and repairing timber structures and fixtures in accordance with construction standards, building codes and project specifications.

Key Responsibilities
•	Interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications to determine materials, measurements and installation requirements.
•	Select and prepare timber and other building materials and organise layouts for carpentry work.
•	Measure, cut and shape timber and related materials using hand and power tools to meet project specifications.
•	Assemble and install structural frameworks, sub-flooring systems and floorboards while ensuring accuracy and stability.
•	Fit and secure building components including door frames, window frames, skirting and other structural fixtures.
•	Construct and join timber components to form structures and fittings ready for installation.
•	Repair, replace or renovate damaged wooden structures, fittings and flooring components as required.
•	Inspect completed carpentry work to ensure compliance with building standards, safety requirements and project specifications.

Essential Skills and Experience
•	AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Carpentry, or an equivalent qualification.
•	Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience as a Carpenter.
•	Strong understanding of construction techniques, timber materials and flooring installation methods.
•	Ability to read and interpret building plans and technical drawings.
•	Proficiency in using carpentry tools, machinery and measuring equipment.

Why Join Our Team
•	Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
•	Stable full-time employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Access to modern tools, equipment and quality materials.
•	Opportunity to work on high-quality residential construction projects with an established Queensland home builder.

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing residential construction company, please submit your resume together with a cover letter outlining your skills, qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Carpenters who are committed to delivering quality workmanship.
